key_insight: MIMIC-Note-Extract converts free-text discharge summaries into reusable structured data, reducing repeated extraction work for clinical AI research.
clinical_relevance: The dataset makes patient history, allergies, and diagnostic findings more accessible for research without establishing readiness for clinical deployment.
method: Process 16 sections from 300,720 MIMIC-IV-Note discharge summaries.
Combine deterministic parsing with schema-guided large language model extraction.
Use structured outputs to build a clinical decision-making benchmark for LLM agents.
evidence_signal: Medical-doctor validation found extraction accuracy above 92% across sections; MNE provides 10 times more patient-history entries and medication histories for more than twice as many admissions as related structured MIMIC tables.
watch_item: The abstract does not detail validation sample sizes or error types, limiting assessment of reliability for specific downstream tasks.
paper_title: MIMIC-Note-Extract: A Large-Scale Structured Dataset Extracted from MIMIC-IV-Note Discharge Summaries
